question: Choose the one word for: A person with wide knowledge of many different subjects.
explanation: Polymath = बहुज्ञ (अनेक विषयों का जानकार)। Example: Leonardo da Vinci was a polymath: painter, scientist and engineer.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who attacks cherished beliefs and traditional institutions.
explanation: Iconoclast = मूर्तिभंजक / परंपराओं पर प्रहार करने वाला। Example: The young poet was an iconoclast who mocked every old tradition.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who is new to a subject or activity; a beginner.
explanation: Neophyte = नौसिखिया / नया दीक्षित। Example: As a neophyte in politics, he made many mistakes.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who believes that pleasure is the chief aim of life.
explanation: Hedonist = सुखवादी (भोग-विलास को जीवन का लक्ष्य मानने वाला)। Example: The hedonist spent his life in parties and luxury.

question: Choose the one word for: One who is easily deceived or cheated.
explanation: Gullible = भोला, आसानी से ठगा जाने वाला। Example: Gullible customers believed the false advertisement.

question: Choose the one word for: That which cannot be satisfied.
explanation: Insatiable = अतृप्त (जिसकी भूख/इच्छा कभी न मिटे)। Example: He had an insatiable thirst for knowledge.

question: Choose the one word for: That which cannot be understood or interpreted.
explanation: Inscrutable = रहस्यमय, जिसे समझना असंभव हो। Example: The monk's inscrutable smile puzzled everyone.

question: Choose the one word for: A medicine that relieves pain.
explanation: Analgesic = दर्द निवारक दवा। Example: The doctor gave him an analgesic for the headache.

question: Choose the one word for: A drug that induces sleep.
explanation: Soporific = नींद लाने वाली दवा। Example: The soporific effect of the tablet made him sleep for hours.

question: Choose the one word for: The killing of one's wife.
explanation: Uxoricide = पत्नी की हत्या। Example: He was convicted of uxoricide after the court examined the evidence.

question: Choose the one word for: The murder of a prominent person for political reasons.
explanation: Assassination = (प्रमुख व्यक्ति की) राजनीतिक हत्या। Example: The assassination of the leader shocked the entire nation.

question: Choose the one word for: An official order or proclamation issued by a ruler or authority.
explanation: Edict = राजाज्ञा / फ़रमान। Example: Emperor Ashoka issued edicts that were carved on rocks and pillars.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who takes refined pleasure in fine food and drink.
explanation: Epicure = उत्तम खान-पान का शौकीन। Example: As an epicure, he chose the restaurant carefully.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who lives outside his native country.
explanation: Expatriate = प्रवासी (अपने देश से बाहर रहने वाला)। Example: Many Indian expatriates work in the Gulf countries.

question: Choose the one word for: A group of islands.
explanation: Archipelago = द्वीप-समूह। Example: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands form an archipelago in the Bay of Bengal.

question: Choose the one word for: A disease that spreads rapidly among many people in a locality at the same time.
explanation: Epidemic = महामारी (किसी क्षेत्र में तेज़ी से फैलने वाला रोग)। Example: An epidemic of dengue broke out in the city.

question: Choose the one word for: A disease regularly found among a particular people or in a certain region.
explanation: Endemic = स्थानिक (किसी क्षेत्र में सदा पाया जाने वाला रोग)। Example: Malaria is endemic in some tropical regions.

question: Choose the one word for: The scientific study of earthquakes.
explanation: Seismology = भूकंप-विज्ञान। Example: Seismology helps scientists to measure the strength of earthquakes.

question: Choose the one word for: The study of fossils.
explanation: Palaeontology = जीवाश्म-विज्ञान। Example: Palaeontology tells us how dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.

question: Choose the one word for: The study of handwriting.
explanation: Graphology = हस्तलेख-विज्ञान। Example: Some experts use graphology to guess a person's character.

question: Choose the one word for: A system of society in which women hold the power.
explanation: Matriarchy = मातृसत्ता। Example: In a matriarchy, property passes through the mother's line.

question: Choose the one word for: An animal that feeds on insects.
explanation: Insectivorous = कीटभक्षी। Example: Bats and frogs are insectivorous animals.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who takes up an art or science in a superficial way, only for pleasure.
explanation: Dilettante = शौकिया, ऊपरी जानकारी रखने वाला कलाप्रेमी। Example: He is a dilettante who dabbles in painting but never finishes a canvas.

question: Choose the one word for: A person regarded as a perfect model of a particular quality.
explanation: Paragon = आदर्श नमूना, उत्कृष्टता का प्रतीक। Example: She was a paragon of honesty and discipline.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who has an aggressive and exaggerated patriotism.
explanation: Chauvinist = उग्र राष्ट्रवादी / अंध-देशभक्त। Example: The chauvinist refused to appreciate anything foreign.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who rebels against an established government.
explanation: Insurgent = विद्रोही। Example: The insurgents attacked the army post at night.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who believes in equal rights and opportunities for all people.
explanation: Egalitarian = समतावादी। Example: An egalitarian society treats all citizens equally.

question: Choose the one word for: A person who is between eighty and eighty-nine years old.
explanation: Octogenarian = अस्सी से नवासी वर्ष की आयु का व्यक्ति। Example: The octogenarian professor still walks two miles every day.

question: Choose the one word for: Something that belongs to a different period of time and looks out of place.
explanation: Anachronism = कालविरुद्ध बात / कालदोष। Example: A mobile phone in a film about ancient Rome would be an anachronism.

question: Choose the one word for: A speech made by a character to himself when alone on the stage.
explanation: Soliloquy = स्वगत-कथन। Example: Hamlet's soliloquy 'To be, or not to be' is world famous.
